groups.label: EMDR
groups.basis: Explicit EMDR intervention or comparison in the publication title or intervention family. Includes related childhood-trauma populations; directness remains record-specific.

groups.label: Mindfulness or meditation
groups.basis: Explicit mindfulness, meditation or MBCT focus in the title or intervention family, including a reported mindfulness component. Yoga alone is not counted as mindfulness.

groups.label: Music-based approaches
groups.basis: Recommended Sound records concern music, music therapy, music listening, musical performance or songwriting. These are not all treatment-efficacy studies.

countingNote: Selected topic counts within the recommended set, not a complete partition. A publication can cover more than one approach. These are publication counts, not independent trials or proof of treatment efficacy.
